articles.title: Tuchel's World Cup Bombshell: Foden, Palmer, Alexander-Arnold Axed
articles.summary: England manager Thomas Tuchel dropped a bombshell by omitting Phil Foden, Cole Palmer, and Trent Alexander-Arnold from his 26-man World Cup squad. Harry Maguire called the decision 'shocking.' Ollie Watkins and Ivan Toney made the cut.

articles.title: The 'Fabulous' Compliment That Helped a Cancer Patient Feel Seen
articles.summary: During chemotherapy for breast cancer, Pat Gentile dreaded going out without her wig. Then a stranger in a convenience store told her she looked 'fabulous.' That moment became a turning point, giving her the courage to face the world.

articles.title: Gabbard Resigns as Intelligence Chief, Citing Husband's Cancer
articles.summary: Tulsi Gabbard resigned as director of national intelligence, saying her husband's rare bone cancer diagnosis requires her full attention. Her departure marks the fourth Cabinet exit in Trump's second term, amid reported tensions over Iran policy.
